history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the secretariat of the Central Emergency Response Fund engage with implementing agencies to minimize requests for extension, carefully review such requests and grant extensions only in genuinely exceptional circumstances.
history.administration_response: In 2021, the secretariat of the Central Emergency Response Fund saw a significant decrease in no-cost extensions compared with 2020, in both absolute and relative terms (13 per cent fewer projects required extensions in 2021). While the secretariat will continue its efforts to further reduce the number of no-cost extensions in the future, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs considers the recommendation implemented in the context of the Board audit, as this will be a permanent, sustained effort by the secretariat, without a specific end date.
history.board_assessment: Given that the project implementation period was extended prior to implementation in 2021, with fewer no-cost extensions, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
